title: How One Text at 11pm Rebuilds Who a Godly Man Calls First
caption:
How one text at 11pm rebuilds who a godly man actually calls first.

Most guys wait until they're wrecked to reach out. That's not humility, that's isolation with a good excuse.

A friend loves at all times, not just the bad ones (Proverbs 17:17). Send the honest text before you need one. Say the real thing, not the church version. Show up uninvited. Let him call you out and stay in the room.

Confess your sins to one another, that you may be healed (James 5:16). That's not a suggestion. That's the whole point of having brothers.
